limitations: Third-party humanitarian compilation, not a government-certified boundary file.
Vintage 2022-09-09: districts created later (e.g. Kot Addu, Murree, Taunsa, Talagang) are absent or merged.
Includes Gilgit-Baltistan and Azad Kashmir as administered units; makes no statement on disputed areas.
Polygon quality was checked structurally only (closed rings, ranges, plausibility, sample overlap test), not for full topological validity.
Names differ from geo.admin_unit; all matching goes through the explicit crosswalk.
